purpose: Central availability registry for analytics capabilities. Availability reflects validated implementation, contract, data, and pipeline evidence. DEFERRED does not mean implementation failure.

rules.PASS: Capability has sufficient validated evidence for current project scope.
rules.PARTIAL: Capability has implementation or tests, but required end-to-end data or pipeline evidence is incomplete.
rules.DEFERRED: Capability is intentionally not activated because required data, schema, or pipeline evidence is not currently available.
rules.FAIL: Capability has a verified implementation, contract, or runtime failure that requires correction.

TEMPORAL_TRENDS.notes: Temporal contract exists as temporal_analytics_contract.json, but its contract status is not declared and the expected implementation/test files were not found by the inventory convention. Do not modify it yet.

ATTACKER_IP_ANALYTICS.notes: A DEFERRED contract exists under analytics/contracts and an ACTIVE contract exists under app/analytics/contracts. Historical 8C data and full pipeline availability are not currently validated. Reconciliation is required later; do not treat test PASS as Real E2E availability.

SESSION_REPLAY.notes: Replay contract and guard implementation exist, but activation waits for the actual contracted ML event output.

global_rules: This registry does not fabricate data availability.
Implementation existence does not imply Real E2E availability.
Passing unit or contract tests does not imply full pipeline availability.
DEFERRED capabilities must remain non-blocking for capabilities already validated.
When deferred source data becomes available, only the affected capability should be revalidated.
Existing PASS capabilities must not be modified merely to activate a deferred capability.
No GeoIP, MITRE, session identifier, or other enrichment may be fabricated to convert DEFERRED into PASS.
